preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through transferOwnership)
Contract must hold some balance of its own tokens (xenoX)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the transferTokens function with the recipient set to your address and amount equal to the contract's token balance. This will drain all xenoX tokens held by the contract itself to the owner's address. The function uses token.transfer(recepient, amount) where token is an IBEP20 interface pointing to the contract's own address.
